title: GenQ: Automated Question Generation to Support Caregivers While Reading Stories with Children

bias_targets.methodology: Statistical analysis of differences in question-asking styles (Concrete, Abstract, Relational) between Hispanic/Latinx and non-Hispanic/Latinx participants, and evaluation of the demographic sensitivity of extracted question templates.
Comparative analysis of the types and frequency of questions asked by caregivers versus non-caregivers to determine representativeness for the target user group.
